metadata.case_name: LEE HOI YIN v. HO KA YIN

plaintiff.occupation_before: Worked in a cake shop operated by Maxims as a cashier
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: Supervisory position in housekeeping in the Hotel Industry
plaintiff.education_level: Attended a course on Hotel Management

injuries.description: Head injuries with intracerebral and subdural haematoma and subarachoid haemorrhage.
source: Head injuries with intracerebral and subdural haematoma and subarachoid haemorrhage.

injuries.description: Fractures of left clavicle, left 2nd to 5th and 7th ribs and left public rami.
injuries.body_part: left clavicle; left ribs; left pubic rami
source: Fractures of left clavicle, left 2nd to 5th and 7th ribs and left public rami.

injuries.description: Two deep lacerations of spleen with active bleeding and a big perinephric haematoma.
source: Two deep lacerations of spleen with active bleeding and a big perinephric haematoma.

injuries.description: Ruptured right kidney with large retroperitoneal and bilateral hemothorax.
source: Ruptured right kidney with large retroperitoneal and bilateral hemothorax.

injuries.description: Pelvic fracture (a pelvic C-clamp was applied for reduction of the pelvic fracture).
source: a pelvic C-clamp was applied for reduction of the pelvic fracture.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pelvic ring with complete disruption of posterior arch

manifestations.description: Stiffness of the left shoulder, the range of motion reduced.
Weakness, paraesthesia and numbness of right lower limb. Diminished ankle movement. The Plaintiff has limping gait on the right side.
Decrease standing tolerance and decrease lifting capacity.
Significant deterioration in her cognitive abilities and loss of memory and learning ability.
Scars over midline of the abdomen, chest and pelvis.
Pain over buttocks, low back, both shoulders and right leg.
The Plaintiff cannot sleep well because of the pain and stiffness over her shoulder.
She suffers emotional stress from the physical disabilities and change of attitude of her boy friend.
Psychological and emotional damage and social deterioration. Weight gain.
She had become introverted and did not seek out company; personality had changed for the worse and she had now become bad tempered and impatient.
Inability to do the necessary mental arithmetic for her job as a cashier; attention span affected and difficulty in following the plot of television shows and popular films causing embarrassment.

treatments_received: The Plaintiff was admitted to the Caritas Medical Centre. Left side chest drain insertion and emergency right renal arteriogram and embolization was done.
Emergency laperotomy and total splenectomy were performed.
Nephrectomy was done on re-laparotomy and a pelvic C-clamp was applied for reduction of the pelvic fracture.
Follow-up CT scan of brain was done on 17th May, 2001 which showed intracranial haematoma with residual hypodense in the right fronto-parietal lobe.
The Plaintiff was diagnosed to have suffered from delusional symptoms and received psychotherapy from clinical psychologist.
The Plaintiff was discharged on 31st May, 2001 and was transferred to Kowloon Hospital for further rehabilitation.

losses.description: Her social life had also deteriorated considerably.
She had become introverted and did not seek out company; personality had changed for the worse and she had now become bad tempered and impatient.
Significant deterioration in her cognitive abilities and loss of memory and learning ability.
Scars over midline of the abdomen, chest and pelvis; she was now unable to wear a bikini to go swimming.
Pain over buttocks, low back, both shoulders and right leg; decreased standing tolerance and lifting capacity.
She had a regular boyfriend and a good prospect of getting married and having a family in due course; one unfortunate consequence was that her boyfriend had left her.
